BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO,

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B1-1 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as

shown on Map No. 28-l in an area bound by:

West 111" Street; a line 75 feet east of and parallel to South Troy Street; the alley next south of and

parallel to West 111" Street; and West Troy Street.

To those of a B3-1 Community Shopping District

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.
